rule_outs: Dwelling 3 m from the best section
summary: 17 m kerb right beside apartments and houses, steep, with a No Stopping sign.

drivers.seclusion: Signature Point apartments 3 m and a detached house 5 m from the kerb; dense housing all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street, west kerb tight against buildings; only 17 m long.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential lane, occasional through traffic.
drivers.convention: 4P parallel signs and a No Stopping Any Time sign cover this kerb.

sun_shade: Apartment block shades the west side in the morning.
